extracted.name: Healthy baked oats
extracted.description: Enjoy these healthy mini oat pots with a topping of yogurt and your favourite berries. Although usually served for breakfast, they make a great little snack
ingredient_lines: 100ml almond milk or milk of your choice
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Beat the milk, egg and oats together with 2 tbsp water, the cinnamon and vanilla essence. Divide between two 165ml ramekins, then bake in the oven for 10 mins until almost set. Top each one with half the yogurt, then dust with cinnamon and top with the berries.
